basics.name: Ariff Azman
basics.label: Infrastructure & Platform Engineer
basics.summary: Infrastructure and platform engineer with a decade of experience delivering cloud-native systems and AI automation across gaming and enterprise environments. Standardized CI/CD across 8 projects, cut release cycle time by 70%, and automated infrastructure management for 1,000+ resources. Combines Terraform, Kubernetes, and cloud-agnostic architecture with hands-on agentic AI and self-hosted LLM tooling, and a record of leading cross-functional delivery, developer onboarding, and operational excellence.
